actionable_sentences: The QueryScene API requires a 'name' parameter of type string to identify the scene being queried.
When requesting information about the 'Morning Routine' scene, the 'name' parameter must be set to 'Morning Routine'.
lifted_nl: The QueryScene API shall require a 'name' parameter of type string when identifying the scene being queried.
If querying the 'Morning Routine' scene, the 'name' parameter shall be set to 'Morning Routine'.
The API response shall include a 'devices' list, and each device in this list shall contain both a 'name' and a 'description' field.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: The scene name must be a non-empty string and must correspond to an existing scene in the smart home system.
operations.Postcondition: The function returns a dictionary representing an API request with ApiName key set to 'QueryScene' and the 'name' parameter correctly set to the requested scene name.
assumptions: The scene 'Morning Routine' exists in the smart home system.
The API service is accessible and capable of returning structured device information.
invariants: The returned API request must contain an 'ApiName' field with value 'QueryScene'.
The 'name' parameter in the returned API request must equal the requested scene name.
Each device entry in the returned 'devices' list must contain both 'name' and 'description' keys.
